scope: Preparation evaluation mechanics only; synthetic tempfile tests, no experiment judgments or outcomes

contracts.review_binding: Review packet_sha256 is required and must match the sealed packet
contracts.native_completion: receipts/events.jsonl terminal native witnesses or runtime.status(); saved bytes alone never imply completion
contracts.packet_writes: Once-only J1/J2 packets and private mappings; deterministic opaque IDs and reversed J2 order
contracts.main_assessments: Separate raw/post execution and assessment; failed D retention is unobservable with explicit disposition
contracts.normalization: Preserve every agreed scalar, source claim/hash and candidate; unresolved scalars null; deterministic family IDs
contracts.adjudication: Optional scalar-only resolutions for declared disputes, with strict enums/types; agreed fields and family edits rejected
contracts.family_disputes: Conservative uncertainty on connected disputed clusters, no semantic adjudication of membership
contracts.p09_blinding: No administrative stratum/reason, method labels, source filenames or evaluator-only D input; full raw sources and case retained
contracts.logs: Check/resolve hashes append to reports/evaluation-events.jsonl separately from native runtime joins
contracts.stage_attribution: raw_judgment_resolved and raw_unresolved_fields exclude retention; full judgment_resolved remains the retained/P10 gate

coverage: family label changes versus co-membership and uncertain-link disagreements
method blinding and full semantic strings
source hash binding and tamper detection
P09 every raw ID in every arm
terminal/native witness status and missing files
retention-only disagreement does not block raw judgment resolution
limitations: Residual method recognizability can remain in full semantic content
Family membership adjudication is intentionally unsupported; disagreements remain uncertain
Preparation tests do not establish semantic research validity

followups.change: Separate raw judgment resolution from retention disputes
followups.regression: All raw scalar judgments agree while D retention differs: raw_judgment_resolved true, judgment_resolved false, retention null
